newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI rises 8.96 pct on 1996 profits news.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI rises 8.96 pct on 1996 profits news.

text.p: International Container Terminal Services Inc (ICTSI) rose by 1.50 peso, or 8.96 percent, to 18.25 pesos in late trade on Monday on higher-than-expected profits for 1996, brokers said.

"The profits were more than what was expected. And for 1997, we believe the company's overseas projects will contribute more to its bottomline," said Alexis Cabel, analyst at Angping & Associates Securities.
Last Friday, the company reported a 65 percent jump in net income in 1996 to 474.7 million pesos compared to 286.7 million in 1995.
